name: Mercury
description: Mercury is the first code efficiency benchmark for Code Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on both functional correctness and computational efficiency of generated code. It contains 1,889 Python tasks with real-world efficiency baselines and introduces a new metric, Beyond, to evaluate runtime-percentile-weighted pass scores.
reputation: A newer code benchmark that has attracted interest for measuring both correctness and efficiency, but it is not yet as established as HumanEval or MBPP.
notes: Introduces a new metric Beyond to jointly evaluate functional correctness and code efficiency; highlights a gap in efficiency of current Code LLMs.
